name: generate_rfq_confirmation
description: Generate a well-structured RFQ confirmation message with summary and outstanding questions

summary.description:
A clear, bullet-pointed summary of the RFQ details collected so far. Start directly with the product section header. Format as:

*Products:*
• [quantity] [unit_of_measures] [product name] (Brand: [brand name if available], Remarks: [remarks if available])
• [next product with same format - create a separate bullet for EACH product]
• [continue for all products]

• *Delivery Location:* [city, state, pincode]
• *Delivery Date:* [date]
• *Remarks:* [any global specifications or remarks if available]
• *Attachments:* [number of files attached, e.g., '1 file attached (filename.jpg)' if attachments exist]

CRITICAL INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Do NOT include 'RFQ Summary:' or 'Confirmation Required' headers - start directly with *Products:*
2. Each product MUST be on its own separate bullet line. Do NOT combine multiple products in one line.
3. Use the EXACT quantity values from the items array in the RFQ data. DO NOT perform any calculations or modifications. If the items array shows quantity=3, write '3', not any other number. Extract quantities directly from the data without any arithmetic.
4. For delivery date, use delivery_date_display if available (formatted as 'DD Month YYYY'), otherwise use delivery_date.
5. If brand, remarks, attachments, or other optional fields are provided, include them in the summary.
6. If there are attachments in the RFQ data, ALWAYS include the attachment count and filenames.
7. Include only the information that has been collected. Do not include sections that have no data.

confirmation_request.description: A friendly request asking the user to confirm or make changes. Keep it natural and encouraging.
